#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

const int A = 26, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
int oo[A * 2 + 5], oh[A * 2 + 5], __ = 1;
int ii[A * 2 + 5], jj[A * 2 + 5], cc[A * 4 + 5], ww[A * 2 + 5], ww_[A * 2 + 5];
int m_ = 0, n_ = 0;
int ae[A * 2 + 5], dd[A * 2 + 5], kk[A * 2 + 5], ff[A * 2 + 5];
int pq[A * 2 + 5], iq[A * 2 + 5], cnt = 0;

int link(int o, int h) {
    oo[__] = o; oh[__] = h;
    return __++;
}

void init() {
    oo[0] = oh[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m_ * 2; i++) {
        oo[i] = oh[i] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m_; i++) {
        ii[i] = jj[i] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++) {
        ae[i] = dd[i] = kk[i] = ff[i] = 0;
    }
    m_ = 0;
}

void link_(int i, int j, int c, int w) {
    int h = m_++;
    ii[h] = i; jj[h] = j; cc[h << 1] = c; ww[h] = w;
    ae[i] = link(ae[i], h << 1);
    ae[j] = link(ae[j], h << 1 | 1);
}

bool less(int u, int v) {
    return dd[u] < dd[v] || (dd[u] == dd[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
}

int i2(int i) {
    return (i *= 2) > cnt ? 0 : i < cnt && less(pq[i + 1], pq[i]) ? i + 1 : i;
}

void pq_up(int u) {
    int i, j, v;
    for (i = iq[u]; (j = i / 2) > 0 && less(u, v = pq[j]); i = j)
        pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
}

void pq_dn(int u) {
    int i, j, v;
    for (i = iq[u]; (j = i2(i)) > 0 && less(v = pq[j], u); i = j)
        pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
    pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
}

void pq_add_last(int u) {
    pq[iq[u] = ++cnt] = u;
}

int pq_remove_first() {
    int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
    if (v != u) {
        iq[v] = 1; pq_dn(v);
    }
    iq[u] = 0;
    return u;
}

bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
    memset(dd, INF, sizeof(dd));
    dd[s] = 0; pq_add_last(s);
    while (cnt > 0) {
        int i = pq_remove_first();
        int k = kk[i] + 1;
        for (int o = ae[i]; o != 0; o = oo[o]) {
            int h_ = oh[o];
            if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                int h = h_ >> 1;
                int j = i ^ ii[h] ^ jj[h];
                int d = dd[i] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? ww_[h] : -ww_[h]);
                if (dd[j] > d || (dd[j] == d && kk[j] > k)) {
                    if (dd[j] == INF)
                        pq_add_last(j);
                    dd[j] = d; kk[j] = k; ff[j] = h_;
                    pq_up(j);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dd[t] != INF;
}

int trace(int s, int t) {
    while (t != s) {
        int h_ = ff[t], h = h_ >> 1;
        cc[h_]--; cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        t ^= ii[h] ^ jj[h];
    }
    return 1;
}

int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
        int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
        dd[j] = min(dd[j], dd[i] + ww[h]);
    }
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
        int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
        ww_[h] = ww[h] + dd[i] - dd[j];
    }
    int f = 0;
    while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
        f += trace(s, t);
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            if (dd[i] != INF && dd[j] != INF) {
                ww_[h] += dd[i] - dd[j];
            }
        }
    }
    int cost = 0;
    for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
        cost += ww[h] * cc[h << 1 | 1];
    return cost;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    n_ = 1 + n + A + 1;
    m_ = n + n * A + A;
    init();
    char cc[n * 2];
    cin >> (cc + 1);
    int bb[n * 2];
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++)
        cin >> bb[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
        int ai = cc[i] - 'a';
        int aj = cc[j] - 'a';
        for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
            int b;
            if (a == ai && a == aj)
                b = max(bb[i], bb[j]);
            else if (a == ai)
                b = bb[i];
            else if (a == aj)
                b = bb[j];
            else
                b = 0;
            link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b);
        }
    }
    int kk[A];
    for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
        int a = cc[i] - 'a';
        kk[a]++;
    }
    for (int a = 0; a < A; a++)
        link_(1 + n + a, n_ - 1, kk[a], 0);
    cout << -edmonds_karp(0, n_ - 1) << endl;
    return 0;
}
